chapter.verse: Kote in ko-le-ko kiphattawm ka hi uh hiam? Ahih kei leh, kiphatna lai note kiangah midangte piak nading ahi zongin, note in midangte kiangah piak nading ahi zongin, kote in mi kimkhat bangin deih ka hi uh hiam?
Note in kei lungtang tungah a kigelh, mi khempeuh in a sim theih kote’ lai na hi uh hi.

Koici bang hiam na cih uh leh, note in laitui tawh kigelh hi lo a, a nungta Pasian’ Kha Siangtho tawh kigelh na hi uh ahi zongin, suangpeek tungah kigelh ahi lo, lungtang satak peek tungah kigelh na hi uh ahi zongin, kote’ nasepna ah Khazih laikhak na hihna uh kitel takin na lak zo uh hi.
Kote in Khazih hangin Pasian mai-ah tua bangin ka lungkim uh hi.
Ahih hangin kote in ko’ siamna suangin komau ut thuin na khat peuhpeuh na hanciam nadingun a hih thei ka hi kei uh hi.

Pasian sungah kihih khinzo bek ahih mah bangin kiciamna thak’ nasemte suah zawh nading siamna Pasian in kote hong pia hi. Tua bang ka cih ciangin Thuciam lui thu cihnopna hi lo, Kha Siangtho thu cihnopna hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Thuciam lui thu in hin’na a that thei hi, Kha Siangtho thu in a hingsak thei hi.

Tua tham loin, a mang thei vangliatna ahi Moses’ maitangah a kilang vangliatna hangin Israel mite in a maitang a tel et ngam loh dongin, suangpeek tungah laimalin kigelh sihna tawh kipawl nasepna in vangliatna tawh a dim leh,
Kha Siangtho tawh kipawl nasepna in vangliatna tawh a dimzaw ding hilo ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mawhna thutanna nasepna in vangliatna a neih leh, tua tham loin dikna nasepna in vangliatna a neizaw ding hi.
Tunung ciangin a hong piang ding vangliatna in a lian mahmah ahih ciangin a omsa vangliatna in a mangthang hi.
A mangthang na in vangliatna a neih leh, a kip na in vangliatna a neizaw ding hi.
Tua bang muan’na ka nei uh ahih ciangin kote in im loin a tel takin ka hilh uh hi.
A mangthang na a beina Israel mite in a tel et loh nadingun Moses in a mai a sit bangin ka hih kei uh hi.
Tuate lungsim in theih hakin, tu-ni dongin thuciamna lui a sim uh ciangin, tua mai sitna in a sin hi; Khazih hangin kipaaikhia zo hi cih a thei kei uh hi.
Tu nangawnin Moses’ lai a sim uh ciangin amau lungsim uh a kisin lai hi.
Ahih hangin Topa kiangah a kihei uh ciangin tua a kisitna a kipaaikhia hi.
‘Topa’ a cih ciangin Kha Siangtho a cihnopna hi. Topa’ Kha Siangtho’ omna-ah suahtak nopsakna a om hi.
Eite khempeuh in mai sitna om loin limlang i et mah bangin Topa’ minthan’na mu-in, Kha Siangtho ahi Topa in hong sawl mah bangin eite minthan’na khang semsemin ama meel sun-in i kikheel hi.
